# K-27: Website Compare mode

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Owner | Krishna |
| Gate | 4 |
| Type | Web |
| Priority | Must-have (M8) |
| Plan first | No |
| Depends on | #27 (K-25), #29 (K-26) |

| Estimated size | L (1–2 days) |

## 1. Goal

Run two or more schedulers on the same jobs side by side in the browser, with timelines, a metrics table and Chart.js charts, falling back to a table when Chart.js cannot load.

## 2. Background

**From BLUEPRINT §5 Compare mode:**

| Mode | What the user does | What they see |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compare | Tick two or more schedulers. Run them on the same jobs | Side-by-side timelines, metrics table, Chart.js charts, and the exact optimum when there are 9 jobs or fewer |

**From PRD §7 compare.js:**

| Script | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `compare.js` | Creates one simulation per selected policy on the same jobs; side-by-side timelines, metrics table, Chart.js charts, exact optimum for 9 jobs or fewer |

**From PRD §8 (Chart.js rule):**

- [ ] The only external request is Chart.js from a CDN, pinned to an exact version with an integrity hash. If it fails, Compare mode falls back to a table.

**From PRD "Version safety rule" (for AI assistants):**

1. Web search each tool for its latest stable release and any security advisory.
2. Cross-check with the registry or official page when a shell is available (`pip index versions <pkg>`, `emsdk list`, the npm or jsDelivr page for Chart.js).
3. Pin CDN scripts to an exact version that has been published for at least two weeks, with a Subresource Integrity hash.
4. State briefly what you verified. Never invent versions.
5. In `requirements.txt`, list names only until the freeze; the lock file holds exact versions.

**From DECISIONS D33:**

| # | Decision | Reason | Rejected alternatives | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D33 | Live visuals on Canvas 2D; Chart.js only in Compare mode, from a CDN pinned to an exact version with SRI, with a table fallback | The page must work if the CDN fails | Chart.js everywhere; an unpinned CDN | PRD §1, §8 |

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- Policy checkboxes; one Sim (handle) per policy, same jobs and capacities
- Side-by-side Gantt timelines and a metrics table
- Chart.js bar charts of key metrics
- Chart.js `<script>` pinned to an exact version at least two weeks old, with an SRI hash, verified and reported
- Table fallback when Chart.js is unavailable

**Out of scope:**

- Exact optimum row (K-33 adds it for ≤ 9 jobs)
- Share links (K-36)

## 4. Files

| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `web/js/compare.js` | create | Compare mode |
| `web/index.html` | modify | Chart.js script tag with SRI; compare panel |
| `docs/TOOLCHAIN.md` | modify | Chart.js version and SRI source |

## 5. Specification

Uses only `aprm_*` exports through `wasm.js`; several handles at once (the core has no globals, D2). Metrics shown are the engine's metrics JSON. Chart.js verified on its npm/jsDelivr page (exact version, published ≥ 2 weeks, SRI hash) before writing the tag.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Verify Chart.js version and SRI; record in TOOLCHAIN.md
2. Create one Sim per policy and run to the end in slices
3. Draw side-by-side timelines
4. Metrics table
5. Charts
6. Fallback with the network off

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `same-as-cli` | Compare aging vs fcfs on a preset | Table equals the CLI metrics for each policy |
| `offline-fallback` | Network off | Table shown, no error |
| `sri-check` | Tamper with the integrity attribute | Browser blocks the script; fallback shown |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Two or more policies side by side (M8)
- [ ] Metrics equal the console program's for the same case
- [ ] With the network off, the table fallback appears
- [ ] Chart.js pinned with SRI; version and source recorded

## 9. How to verify

Open `web/index.html`, compare all policies on each preset, compare with `build/aprm --metrics`; then repeat offline.

## 10. Viva notes

**Idea:** the same C engine runs several times in parallel on the same input; differences come only from the policy.
**Examiner question:** "What if the CDN is down during the viva?" — Compare mode shows a table instead; nothing else depends on the network.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Version from memory
- Forgetting `crossorigin` with SRI
- Leaking handles when the user re-runs compare
